name: Atlantic.vc
mood: Midnight command center with deep black surfaces, blue-white readouts, orange ignition edges, Monument display type, and spaced mono copy.

deepMidnight.role: Page background and immersive section surface.

graphiteBase.role: Selected body sections and intermediate panels.

coolStone.role: Elevated cards and distinct content blocks.

ghostInk.role: Primary text, link text, navigation, and outlined button borders.

mutedAsh.role: Secondary text, helper copy, and neutral link borders.

subtleGrey.role: Decorative borders and lower-emphasis body text.

electricBlue.role: Highlight terms, interactive states, small decorative bands, and blue readouts.

ignitionOrange.role: Action text, tag outlines, dividers, focused edges, and icon accents.

fallbacks.mono: Space Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

rules: Use Monument-style type for headlines, navigation, and prominent text.
Use Mono-style type for body, labels, and code-like details.
Use negative tracking on large Monument headings.
Use generous positive tracking on Mono body and caption text.

components.name: Ghost Navigation Link
components.recipe: Transparent background, no border, no radius, Monument 400, Ghost Ink text.

components.name: Outlined Action Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px Ghost Ink border, Ghost Ink text, 0px radius, Monument 16px.

components.name: Text Accent Button
components.recipe: Transparent background, no border, 0px radius, Monument text in Ignition Orange.

components.name: Standard Card
components.recipe: Cool Stone or Charcoal Canvas surface, 16px radius, no heavy border, no shadow, restrained padding.

components.name: Hero Large Card
components.recipe: Charcoal Canvas surface, 24px radius, large internal padding around 150px vertical and 110px horizontal.

components.name: Company Grid
components.recipe: Full-bleed or horizontal logo grid on dark surfaces with Ghost Ink labels and subtle blue/noise treatment.

components.name: Sticky Top Bar
components.recipe: Minimal sticky dark nav with sparse links and orange or outlined action, no filled CTA.

do: Prioritize Ghost Ink for primary text and interactive outlines.
Use Electric Blue for key terms, readouts, and small interactive states.
Use Ignition Orange for action edges, tags, dividers, and focused UI.
Use Monument for display and navigation.
Use Mono for body, labels, and technical copy.
dont: Do not use light page backgrounds.
Do not add bold colors beyond Electric Blue and Ignition Orange.
Do not use heavy shadows or excessive elevation.
Do not change the specified tracking character of Monument and Mono.
Do not use large filled buttons.
Do not force a strict page-level max width.

imagery.style: Product and tech visuals, partner logos, abstract digital noise, blue-toned textures, and structured headshot grids.
rules: Use company/logo grids as product proof.
Use Electric Blue and Ignition Orange only as small icon or edge accents.

layout.structure: Full-bleed dark sections with generous inner padding and implied columns rather than one strict page max-width.
layout.navigation: Sticky minimal top bar with sparse links and outlined or orange text action.
layout.sectionRhythm: Fluid 50px to 100px vertical spacing with centered stacks and horizontal grids.
